UIKit-only KVC binding (SJUIViewCreator sets view.binding / bindingSet). The last Ruby reader was sjui's table_converter.rb, folded into the Collection route when 49-E ruled Table is a Collection — so this became unread by that ruling, not by anything failing. The declaration says it is superseded by `@{...}` in the attribute value itself; the UIKit runtime still honours it for layouts that predate that, which is why it is not deleted. Reason `legacy` rather than `unimplemented`: nothing is missing.
